TitleOrder laboratory consumables in SupplyDeskDocument VersionV1
SAMPLE DOCUMENT — FICTIONAL CONTENT
Used by the SOPHIA tests and the agent kit. Example Labs and SupplyDesk do not exist.

SCOPE

Describe how a laboratory technician orders consumables in SupplyDesk, follows the approval and receives the delivery at the correct location.

GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS

Orders above the monthly budget of the cost centre need the approval of the laboratory manager. The Catalogue tab only shows items from contracted suppliers.

  • Use the catalogue item number, not the supplier reference.
  • Hazardous items are delivered only to the chemical store.
  • The approval limit per order is TO BE CONFIRMED.

PROCEDURES

Sign in to SupplyDesk

  1. Open SupplyDesk from the intranet start page.
  2. Sign in with your company account.
  3. Check that your cost centre is shown at the top right.

Create the order

Select New order, search the item by its catalogue number and enter the quantity in Quantity.

Confirmation required: check whether frozen items can be ordered on Fridays.

Send the order for approval

  1. Select Submit order.
  2. Wait for the approval e-mail from the laboratory manager.
  3. If the order is rejected, read the comment, correct the order and submit it again.

Choose the delivery option

OptionWhen to use it
LaboratoryStandard consumables for daily work.
Chemical storeHazardous or flammable items.
Cold roomItems that must stay below 8 °C.

REVIEW POINTS AND SOURCE

  • Confirm the approval limit with Finance.
  • Confirm the Friday rule for frozen items.

Report errors in this instruction to the document owner.
